senses.example: Skibet ændrede kurs for at undgå stormen.
senses.example_translation: The ship changed course to avoid the storm.

senses.example: De elskede med hinanden hele natten.
senses.example_translation: They made love to each other all night.

senses.example: Nyheden bredte sig hurtigt i byen.
senses.example_translation: The news spread quickly in the city.

senses.example: Sletten breder sig foran os.
senses.example_translation: The plain spreads out in front of us.

senses.example: Jeg kom i tanke om, at jeg havde glemt mine nøgler.
senses.example_translation: I remembered that I had forgotten my keys.

senses.example: Jeg kom i tanker om, at jeg havde glemt min nøgle.
senses.example_translation: I remembered that I had forgotten my key.

senses.example: Du er forkert på den, hvis du tror, jeg kommer i morgen.
senses.example_translation: You're wrong if you think I'll come tomorrow.

senses.example: Vi ringer sammen hver aften inden sengetid.
senses.example_translation: We call each other every evening before bedtime.

senses.example: Virksomheden skar ned på udgifterne sidste år.
senses.example_translation: The company cut back on expenses last year.

senses.text: to get married (become husband and wife)
senses.example: De blev mand og kone i en lille kirke sidste sommer.
senses.example_translation: They became husband and wife in a small church last summer.

senses.text: there is pressure, things are hectic
senses.example: Der er pres på i køkkenet lige før gæsterne kommer.
senses.example_translation: There is pressure in the kitchen just before the guests arrive.

senses.example: Hun gjorde tegn til tjeneren, at hun ville betale.
senses.example_translation: She motioned to the waiter that she would pay.

senses.text: to make a sign (to do something)
senses.example: Han gjorde tegn til, at vi skulle følge med.
senses.example_translation: He motioned for us to follow.

senses.example: Det tegner til at blive en god dag.
senses.example_translation: It promises to be a good day.

senses.example: Jeg tager en ekstra trøje på for at holde mig varm.
senses.example_translation: I put on an extra sweater to keep warm.

senses.example: Soldaterne gik til angreb ved daggry.
senses.example_translation: The soldiers attacked at dawn.

senses.text: to be mistaken, to be wrong
senses.example: Jeg tror, du er galt på den med den information.
senses.example_translation: I think you're wrong about that information.

senses.example: Vi talte forbi hinanden hele aftenen og blev uvenner.
senses.example_translation: We talked past each other all evening and fell out.

senses.example: Politiet måtte gribe ind, da demonstrationen blev voldelig.
senses.example_translation: The police had to intervene when the demonstration turned violent.

senses.example: Hun fik styr på sine papirer inden mødet.
senses.example_translation: She got her papers in order before the meeting.

senses.example: Bilen er i bevægelse, selv om den kører langsomt.
senses.example_translation: The car is moving, even though it is moving slowly.

senses.example: Læreren gjorde opmærksom på fejlen i teksten.
senses.example_translation: The teacher pointed out the error in the text.

senses.example: De stod ansigt til ansigt i den lille elevator.
senses.example_translation: They stood face to face in the small elevator.

senses.text: to be able to touch the bottom (in water)
senses.example: Han kan bunde i den lave ende af poolen.
senses.example_translation: He can touch the bottom in the shallow end of the pool.

senses.example: Han giftede sig ind i en rig familie.
senses.example_translation: He married into a wealthy family.

senses.example: Hun vil gerne skaffe sig af med sin gamle cykel.
senses.example_translation: She wants to get rid of her old bike.

senses.example: Børnene sad oppe til midnat i går.
senses.example_translation: The children stayed up until midnight yesterday.

senses.example: At spare penge er det første skridt mod en bedre økonomi.
senses.example_translation: Saving money is the first step towards a better economy.

senses.example: Jeg har fat i din taske.
senses.example_translation: I am holding your bag.

senses.example: Fuglen fløj ind ad vinduet.
senses.example_translation: The bird flew in through the window.

senses.text: to get carried away talking (and lose track of time)
senses.example: Vi løb med snak og glemte helt aftensmaden.
senses.example_translation: We got carried away talking and completely forgot about dinner.

senses.example: De fører en samtale om vejret.
senses.example_translation: They have a conversation about the weather.

senses.example: Jeg tager tøj på, inden jeg går ud.
senses.example_translation: I get dressed before I go out.

senses.example: Mange vælger at investere i aktier.
senses.example_translation: Many people choose to invest in stocks.

senses.example: Han drak op og gik hjem.
senses.example_translation: He drank up and went home.

senses.example: Han drikker sig fuld hver fredag.
senses.example_translation: He gets drunk every Friday.

senses.example: Han drak tæt hele weekenden.
senses.example_translation: He drank heavily all weekend.

senses.example: Pas på du ikke brænder dig på den varme pande.
senses.example_translation: Be careful not to burn yourself on the hot pan.

senses.example: Mange investorer brændte sig på aktiemarkedet sidste år.
senses.example_translation: Many investors got burned on the stock market last year.

senses.example: Jeg brænder ud, hvis jeg arbejder for meget.
senses.example_translation: I burn out if I work too much.

senses.example: De mørke skyer tyder på regn.
senses.example_translation: The dark clouds indicate rain.

senses.example: Hun løftede op i låget for at kigge ned i gryden.
senses.example_translation: She lifted the lid slightly to look into the pot.

senses.text: to lift, to rise (of fog, curtain)
senses.example: Tågen løftede sig langsomt over marken.
senses.example_translation: The fog slowly lifted over the field.

senses.text: to manifest itself, to make itself felt (of a feeling, pain)
senses.example: Trætheden begyndte at meddele sig efter den lange gåtur.
senses.example_translation: The fatigue began to manifest itself after the long walk.

senses.example: Pakken er undervejs og kommer i morgen.
senses.example_translation: The package is on its way and will arrive tomorrow.
